company_name: IRSA Inversiones Y Representaciones S.A. Global
title: Cash Dividend Payment
summary: La entrada Cash Dividend Payment se publicó primero en IRSA .
body_markdown:
##### The Company informs that in accordance with the resolution of the Ordinary and Extraordinary General Shareholders’ Meeting dated October 22, 2026 and the Board of Directors meeting, held on the same date, a cash dividend of ARS 211,000,000,000, charged to the year ended on June 30, 2026, equivalent to 2,494.10459277493% of the stock capital with collection right represented by a total of 845,994,994 shares with a par value ARS 10, will be made available to the shareholders as of November 3, 2026, or on the subsequent date resulting from the application of the regulations in the jurisdictions where the Company’s shares are listed.


The amount per ordinary share (PV ARS 10) will be ARS 249.410459277493 and the amount per each Global Depositary Share (GDS) will be ARS 2,494.10459277493, payable to all shareholders that have such quality as of October 26, 2026, according to the registry held by Caja de Valores S.A.


Payment will be made through Caja de Valores S.A., at its address located at 25 de Mayo 362, City of Buenos Aires, from 10 am to 3 pm.


Within the framework of Section 3.4 (Payments of profits and dividends) of the Foreign Exchange Regulations of the Central Bank of the Argentine Republic, foreign shareholders will have the option to receive the Dividend in US dollars, provided that the Company has access to the Argentine Foreign Exchange Market (MULC), at the exchange rate applicable by the financial institution involved in such transaction (the “Option”); otherwise, they will receive the Dividend in Argentine pesos. For this purpose, foreign shareholders electing to exercise the Option must notify Caja de Valores S.A. on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, between 9:00 am and 3:00 pm, following the procedures established by that entity for such purpose (the “Exercise Period”). The Company reserves the right to request any documentation it reasonably deems necessary to verify foreign shareholder status and, at its sole discretion, to deem the Option invalid.


GDS holders will receive the corresponding dividend amounts through The Bank of New York Mellon, depositary of said certificates as of the date resulting from the application of the regulations applicable in the jurisdiction where the Company’s GDSs are listed.


It is made known that the distribution of dividends is subject to the 7% withholding tax established in section 97 of the Income Tax Law (Decree 824/2019 and modifications).​​​​​​​
